list.title: Machine blueprints
list.description: What one kind of machine should deliver – a welding machine, a compressor. A blueprint is advice: it lists the signals you expect, and device profiles and assets are compared with it.
list.emptyText: A machine blueprint lists the signals that are advisable for one kind of machine. Assign it to a device profile or an asset to see what is covered and what is missing.
list.whoCanAct: Plant designers and administrators add machine blueprints.
list.noMatch: No machine blueprint matches the search.
list.name: Name
